set.body:
Outcome

Pin ScalaFIM to the exact locus4s revision produced by external epic bd-01KZ6B4SF3BS6YH7SHEERM9V6H and verified by gate bd-01KZ6B6WCMA9XQ5WAWGXBW3MZ5 before migrating consumers.

Work

- Record the exact provider commit and its JVM, Scala.js, optimized Scala.js, docs, performance, and downstream-probe receipts.
- Update the direct locus4s pin without implicit sibling resolution.
- Confirm the resolved source graph exposes the expected core/data API and no incompatible duplicate locus4s revision.
- Compile focused ScalaFIM seams using PartialSurjection, Field, and NeighborhoodSystem before broad migration.

Acceptance

- The exact provider SHA and evidence are noted on this bead.
- Focused JVM and Scala.js consumer probes pass.
- Dependency resolution is reproducible and does not rely on an uncommitted sibling checkout.
- Failure to meet the provider contracts blocks the migration children rather than triggering local reimplementation.
set.title: Admit the completed locus4s provider revision into ScalaFIM
